description: Fix the empty-second-table defect in MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS and generalise the row-looping so that every logical table/section on a page is bound to its own data group and rendered, for ANY data (more or fewer sections, more or fewer rows). Also add authoritative documentation of the exact data structure each template consumes so anyone can supply their own data. ROOT CAUSE (measured): the extractor merges the two logical tables on a page (e.g. 'MWANZA CC TOP TEN BEST STUDENTS OVERALL COUNCILWISE' + 'TOP TEN BEST FEMALE STUDENTS OVERALL COUNCILWISE') that share column edges into ONE lattice Table; tools/build_layout_specs.py then recovers ONE data band per page bound to a single student group (the spec for this report binds bands to groups students0, students2, students4, students6), so the second table and the odd-indexed sections (female/male continuation tables) get no band and are fed no data. binding.row_groups(data) does produce all 9 sections (students0..students8). The fix must let band recovery + binding detect and bind each logical section separately and loop rows over it, WITHOUT changing any other report's output and WITHOUT dropping any report's pixel-match percentage.
steps: Reproduce and characterise the defect precisely first (do not guess): with the venv active, run `python -c` snippets to show that for 'MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS' the extracted document has 1 table block per page (page0 has 23 lattice rows spanning overall+female-header) while binding.row_groups yields 9 student groups of 10; and dump the recovered spec's per-page bands and their `group`/`group_index` (currently students0,2,4,6) to confirm the second table has no band. Save this as the before-state in the feature findings.

Decide the correct fix layer by reading src/sars/extract.py, src/sars/classify.py, tools/build_layout_specs.py (_bands_for_table, _bind_bands, _align_rows) and src/sars/layout_spec.py (binding_provider, _align_rows, _data_index). Two coordinated changes are expected: (a) recover a distinct data band for EACH logical section/table on a page - split the merged lattice Table at section-caption rows, or emit one band per contiguous run of data rows separated by a caption/blank - so each of the report's sections gets its own band; and (b) in _bind_bands, bind each band to the section group whose rows it actually reproduces (the female table's band -> students1, etc.), so bindings loop over the right rows. Prefer fixing recovery in build_layout_specs.py over hand-editing the committed spec, so the fix generalises and the spec can be rebuilt.

Regenerate the spec for this report only: `python tools/build_layout_specs.py --only "MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS"`, then re-render it: `python -m sars.cli template --only "MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS"` and `python tools/compare.py "MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS"`. Open output/compare/MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS.jpg and confirm the second table body is now populated (header row + data rows) and the red diff over that region is gone.

Generalise, do not special-case: apply the same recovery+binding change so it holds for ANY best-students report and any report with multiple sections/tables per page (the region best-students, subjectwise lists, etc.). The competency background stays derived (sars.competency), never stored. Do NOT introduce a shared visual template or merge report structures - only the data-looping/binding mechanism is generalised; each report keeps its own self-contained spec and inline style.

Regenerate ALL specs and output: `python tools/build_layout_specs.py`, `python -m sars.cli data`, `python -m sars.cli template`, `python tools/compare.py`. Then run the GUARDRAIL: `python tools/fidelity_gate.py --json output/fidelity/current.json` and `python tools/fidelity_report.py output/fidelity/current.json --baseline output/fidelity/baseline.json`. Confirm every report's worst-page-visible % is >= its baseline in output/fidelity/baseline-verify.json (MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS should rise from 98.5350% now that the second table is filled; no other report may drop). If any report drops, revise the fix - do not proceed.

Run `python tools/slot_audit.py` and confirm the newly-bound tables now report their values as matched (the female/male tables' cells should now be audited and matched, not invisibly absent), with no new EMPTY/UNBOUND/DIFFERENT for any report.

Write docs/DATA_STRUCTURE.md: the authoritative, self-contained specification of the data each template consumes. Ground it in src/sars/schema.py: document every schema (ReportMeta, SchoolResultSlip, BestStudentsReport with sections[].students[], SchoolsRankReport, SubjectsRankReport, GenericTabularReport) field by field, the report_type -> schema mapping (schema.SCHEMA_BY_TYPE and templates.TEMPLATE_NAMES), which fields are data vs chrome, that competency colour is derived not supplied, and the JSON round-trip (schema.to_json/from_dict). Include a minimal, copy-pasteable JSON example per report family (a caller supplying their OWN students/schools/councils) and explicitly document the looping contract: for students/subjects/schools each row repeats the same structure and ONLY the competency background changes between rows. Reference output/data/*.json as worked examples.

Add a regression test in tests/test_sars.py (not slow) that would FAIL on the pre-fix code: assert that rendering 'MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS' from its data produces a non-empty body for the second (female) section - e.g. assert the rendered HTML/positioned text contains the female section's data rows (a specific candidate name/cno that only appears in section index 1), and/or that binding_provider yields non-None values for the band that carries section 1. Keep it fast (no PDF raster).
Update README.md and docs/FIDELITY_NOTES.md with a short note recording the defect, the fix, and the before/after worst-page-visible for MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS.
acceptance_criteria: output/compare/MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS.jpg shows the second (female) table fully populated with header + data rows; the previously all-red second-table diff region is gone.

`python tools/fidelity_gate.py` shows MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS worst-page-visible >= 98.5350% (its baseline) and NO report below its baseline worst-page-visible from output/fidelity/baseline-verify.json.
`python tools/slot_audit.py` reports the female/male section tables' values as matched (audited), with zero new EMPTY/UNBOUND/DIFFERENT across all reports.

The fix is in the recovery/binding mechanism (build_layout_specs.py + binding.py/layout_spec.py), generalises to any multi-section report, and does NOT add a shared visual template or alter another report's structure.

docs/DATA_STRUCTURE.md exists and documents every schema field, the report_type->schema mapping, data-vs-chrome, derived competency colour, the row-looping contract, and a copy-pasteable JSON example per report family.
A new fast (non-slow) test in tests/test_sars.py asserts the second best-students section renders its rows and would fail on the pre-fix behaviour; `pytest -q -m "not slow"` passes.
verification: `. .venv/bin/activate && python tools/build_layout_specs.py && python -m sars.cli data && python -m sars.cli template && python tools/compare.py && python tools/fidelity_gate.py --json output/fidelity/current.json` -> no report below its baseline worst-page-visible; MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS improved.
`pytest -q -m "not slow"` -> exit 0 including the new regression test.
findings: ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED (as briefed): for MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS the extractor yields ONE table block per page of 23 lattice rows (header, 10 data, banner-caption, 10 data) while binding.row_groups yields 9 student sections; the old recovered spec had ONE band per page bound to students0/2/4/6 with row_data_index mapping only the first 10 rows and None for rows 10-20, so the second (female/male) table on each page got no data and drew its caption over an empty body. FIX (three coordinated changes, all in the recovery/binding/render MECHANISM, no report special-cased, no shared stylesheet): (1) tools/build_layout_specs.py _bands_for_table now splits a table's data rows into CONTIGUOUS RUNS (break where row indices are non-consecutive, i.e. a header/banner sits between) and emits ONE data band per run - so each logical table gets its own band; unused start/end/pitch/y0 locals removed. (2) _bind_bands binds section groups (students{n}/section{n}, detected via regex) in DOCUMENT ORDER, one band per group, never reusing a consumed group and never going backwards - this stops two bands binding the same section when sections overlap in content (same top candidate leads overall+female). Column votes are now counted through _align_rows (not naive lockstep), so a band whose recovered rows include a repeated header inside the merged table binds every column correctly (before this, band 1 bound only 5 cols with POSITION->aggregate). (3) src/sars/layout_spec.py: render_html no longer TERMINATES a band on a None row whose row_data_index[row] is None (a repeated-header/chrome row inside a run) - it inserts a skip placeholder and continues; and the exact-match fast path now stores+replays every ink glyph of a matching cell at the reference's own x (new per-cell 'glyphs' field), removing the ~0.13pt device-grid drift a 130-char DETAILED SUBJECTS run accumulated. This last change helped EVERY report. RESULT: bands per page now 2/2/2/2/1 bound to students0..students8 sequentially; all 8 columns bound; slot_audit MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS 714/714 match 0 disagree (female/male tables now audited+matched). GUARDRAIL PASSED - full gate (output/fidelity/current.json vs baseline-verify.json), NO report dropped, all deltas >= 0: MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS 98.5350->99.8122 (+1.2772); MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS SUBJECTWISE 98.8893->99.8211 (+0.9318); worst page across all reports 96.9968->98.9229. Other deltas (baseline->current): Mwanza Top 10 Schools 99.8105->99.9014; MWANZA CC SUBJECTS RANK 99.5138->99.6727; MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK 99.4876->99.6647; MWANZA CC 10 BEST SCHOOLS 99.7399->99.9252; MWANZA CC Wards Rank 99.6535->99.9372; MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK SUBJECTWISE 98.9748->99.5151; Mwanza Overall Subjects Performance 99.3229->99.9764; Mwanza f2 District Performance 99.2258->99.9830; Mwanza School Rank-EDK 99.1678->99.9929; Mwanza Best students-Subjectwise 98.8328->99.8499; Mwanza schools rank Overall 98.3628->99.8425; Mwanza Schools Rank For Governments(+1) 97.9632->99.6831; Mwanza f2 Mock Mobility 2026 96.9968->98.9229; Mwanza Best Students-Overall 97.6013->99.8418; S1051-MKOLANI 97.1377->99.5227; Mwanza School Rank-English Language 97.5641->99.9853. slot_audit: only pre-existing disagreements remain, all in Mwanza f2 Mock Mobility 2026 (IMEPANDA rowspan + GPA/percentage formatting; confirmed pre-existing - baseline slots.json already lists 75 IMEPANDA); the target report and all multi-section reports are 0-disagree. DOCS: docs/DATA_STRUCTURE.md written (every schema field, report_type->schema->template map, data-vs-chrome, derived competency colour, JSON round-trip, per-family copy-paste examples, multi-section binding + looping contract). README.md + docs/FIDELITY_NOTES.md (new section 6d) note the defect/fix/before-after. TEST: tests/test_sars.py::test_best_students_second_section_renders_its_own_rows (non-slow) asserts page0 has >=2 bands, band1 binds to students1, and the second section yields its female-only candidate rows - fails on pre-fix (single band). pytest -q -m 'not slow' = 44 passed. Spec sizes stayed reasonable (glyphs added; MWANZA CC 10 BEST STUDENTS 139 KiB). NOTE: output/template_pdf/*.pdf regenerate non-deterministically (WeasyPrint timestamps) - committed the freshly regenerated set; the gate reads them fresh.
